repo-531 linkding: close call. Postgres is supported (LD_DB_ENGINE=postgres) but the Huey queue (SqliteHuey data/tasks.sqlite3), assets, previews and secret key stay on local disk, so NOT_COMPATIBLE with local-filesystem. worker=true from supervisord-tasks.conf although bootstrap.sh starts it in-process. Dockerfile is docker/default.Dockerfile, not a root file.

repo-532 pretix: close call. Postgres is supported, Redis/Celery broker is optional (redis=false), but /data media volume and nginx-served media make it NOT_COMPATIBLE. Health path /healthcheck/ comes from src/pretix/urls.py.

repo-533 atuin: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION because host defaults to 127.0.0.1, db_uri has no default (server.toml also shows sqlite and mysql) and the image has ENTRYPOINT without CMD (start subcommand needed). Migrations run inside server startup, so migration=false.

repo-534 HAPI FHIR: default datasource is in-memory H2; Postgres needs SPRING_DATASOURCE_* and HIBERNATE_DIALECT env. migration=false (hbm2ddl update at startup). Dockerfile has several targets; the last one (default) is labeled.

repo-535 sure: close call between READY and NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Active Storage defaults to local disk (ACTIVE_STORAGE_SERVICE must be amazon), and the sidekiq worker command is only in compose.example.yml and Procfile.dev. migration=true from db:prepare in bin/docker-entrypoint.

repo-536 InvoiceShelf: defaults to SQLite and local storage; supports pgsql and s3. Queue default is sync, so worker=false; the scheduler runs in-container through s6 and is not a declared worker. migration=true from the entrypoint script.
repo-537 actual: root Dockerfile is a development container; the production image is sync-server.Dockerfile. SQLite and files under /data make it NOT_COMPATIBLE.

repo-538 pocketbase: no Dockerfile in the repo and data in pb_data (SQLite); NOT_COMPATIBLE. dockerfilePath omitted. Port 8090 and /api/health are the serve defaults, but the default bind is 127.0.0.1.
repo-539 navidrome: SQLite plus /data and /music volumes; NOT_COMPATIBLE. /ping is a middleware heartbeat. monorepo=false although plugins/ has separate go.mod files.

repo-540 excalidraw: static nginx image, READY. runtime=node (build stage) and healthPath '/'; collaboration uses external Firebase, not counted as a Deployz service. Compose file is development-only.
Pocketbase and the other Go/SQLite apps use only the local-filesystem unsupported tag; the UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES list has no sqlite name.
Validation used a zod copy plus the real expectedFactsSchema through tsx; no scratchpad file is listed as evidence.
